Description: Second-Generation (2G) lignocellulosic bioethanol or First-Generation sugar/starch fermentation for transport fuel blending (E20 mandate).
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: High holocellulose (cellulose + hemicellulose > 55%) or high free sugars (>20%), low lignin or amenable pretreatment.
Environmental_Benefit: Displaces fossil gasoline, reduces GHG emissions by up to 86%, prevents open field stubble burning.

Description: Anaerobic digestion of organic biomass yielding biomethane (CBG) and organic digestate fertilizer (SATAT initiative).
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: High moisture (65-90%), balanced C:N ratio (20:1 - 30:1), high volatile solids, low heavy metals.
Environmental_Benefit: Replaces LPG/CNG, generates odorless bio-slurry fertilizer, mitigates leachate pollution.

Description: Mechanical densification of dry biomass into high-calorific solid fuel logs or pellets for industrial boilers and co-firing.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Low moisture (<15%), moderate-to-high lignin (>15%) for natural binding, low silica ash (<10%).
Environmental_Benefit: Direct substitute for coal in thermal power plants and industrial furnaces.

Description: Aerobic microbial decomposition producing stabilized, humic-rich organic manure for soil conditioning.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Moisture 40-60%, C:N ratio ~30:1, adequate porosity and aeration.
Environmental_Benefit: Restores soil organic carbon (SOC), enhances microbial biodiversity and moisture retention.

Description: Earthworm-assisted bio-oxidation converting tender agricultural residues into premium vermicast fertilizer.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Non-toxic, low tannin/alkaloid content, moderate moisture (60-70%), tender/soft fibrous tissue.
Environmental_Benefit: High plant-available NPK and growth hormones without synthetic chemical inputs.

Description: Solid substrate cultivation of edible/medicinal mushrooms (e.g. Oyster, Paddy Straw) followed by spent mushroom substrate (SMS) composting.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Clean, uninfected straw/cobs/haulms, low agrochemical residue, C:N ratio 50:1 - 80:1.
Environmental_Benefit: Generates high-value human food protein while converting lignified substrate into high-grade compost.

Description: Direct or ensiled fodder utilization for livestock and dairy cattle nutrition.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Non-toxic, high palatability, crude protein >7%, absence of mold or excessive silica.
Environmental_Benefit: Supports rural circular economy and reduces external fodder purchase costs.

Description: High-temperature pyrolysis for biochar, activated carbon, and cellulose fibre pulp for packaging/insulation.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Extremely high carbon/lignin content, structural rigidity, low moisture.
Environmental_Benefit: Long-term geological carbon sequestration and replacement of synthetic plastics/mined carbon.

Description: Low AI confidence or ambiguous sample requiring farmer questionnaire clarification or laboratory verification.
Key_Feedstock_Requirements: Clear photographic re-capture or physical sample submission.
Environmental_Benefit: Prevents process failures and economic losses from misclassification.
